Page.description:
Pagination parameters.

Attributes:
    limit: Maximum number of records to return (must be > 0).
    offset: Number of records to skip (>= 0).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (> 0).

Sort.description:
Ordering parameters.

Attributes:
    field: Mechanism field to sort by (e.g. "created_at", "expire_at").
    direction: asc / desc.

field.description: Mechanism field to sort by; must be within the contract whitelist for the queried domain.
field.title: Field

Sort.title: Sort

TimeRange.description:
Absolute time range filter (mechanism field).

Attributes:
    start: Inclusive range start (None = unbounded).
    end: Exclusive range end (None = unbounded).

end.description: Exclusive range end, timezone-aware UTC (None = unbounded). Omitted when None.

start.description: Inclusive range start, timezone-aware UTC (None = unbounded). Omitted when None.
